rules.name: dependency: web concern in a service
rules.message: services must not reference request/response - pass plain data in

rules.name: boundary: business logic in a component
rules.message: move business rules out of UI components into a service

rules.name: ownership: write into another module's table
rules.message: write through the owning module's interface, not its tables

rules.name: dependency: literal /admin in nav-data href (basePath double-prefix)
rules.message: nav-data href must be basePath-relative; a literal /admin double-prefixes to /admin/admin/... (ADR-0014, hardened in ADR-0018 to also catch the object-literal href: form)
